evidence.quote: The Federal Reserve retains powerful policy tools and will use them aggressively to help achieve this objective.
we see little risk of inflation in the near term; indeed, we expect inflation to continue to moderate.
The damage, in terms of lost output, lost jobs, and lost wealth, is already substantial.
The Committee is also evaluating the possibility of purchasing longer-term Treasury securities.
economic conditions are likely to warrant an unusually low federal funds rate for some time.
they allow the Federal Reserve to continue to push down interest rates and ease credit conditions in a range of markets, despite the fact that the federal funds rate is close to its zero lower bound.

parsed.rationale: The speech describes a severe downturn, says inflation will keep moderating, and signals aggressive further easing through credit-easing tools, possibly including Treasury purchases. Its discussion of an exit strategy is framed as a distant, conditional matter.
